property_summary: After Alice deposits 1 ether, MinSum is set to 1, then Alice calls Collect(1): in the reference contract the balance becomes 0 and the call succeeds (sends 1 ether), while in the buggy contract the balance becomes -1 (underflow revert) because Deposit subtracted 1 from 0, so Collect fails.
change_summary: Replace the addition in balances update with subtraction, so Deposit decreases the balance instead of increasing it.
